vectors.note: tiny-regex-c (the retired C engine) did not support groups: '(' and ')' were literal characters, so this pattern could not match and the C suite recorded the opposite outcome (see retiredCResult). Go RE2 supports groups; expectation deliberately updated per DIVERGENCES.md.
